name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's passion for motorsport began with virtual racing, spending countless hours fine-tuning setups and analyzing telemetry data. This dedication led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he specialized in vehicle dynamics. His career started as a junior data analyst for a Formula Student team, before transitioning to CRG Racing Team as a simulator engineer. 

Dimitri's pragmatic approach focuses on extracting tangible performance gains from the simulator. He meticulously validates simulation models against real-world data, ensuring accuracy and reliability. He's known for his ability to quickly identify areas for improvement and implement effective solutions, making him a valuable asset to the team. His focus on real-world application and quantifiable gains defines his working style.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Dimitri is of average height with a focused gaze and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook for jotting down observations and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of Russian tea, which he brews in his office.
